'''Kubaz cigarras''' were a make of [[Cigarra/Legends|cigarra]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|reign]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They shared their name<ref name="VSV" /> with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> During his [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Master-Com]] would offer the station's most wealthy [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] Kubaz cigarras alongside snifters of [[Cassandran brandy]] or the illegal beverage [[Survapierre]] while he entertained them with highly realistic [[Morphometric technology|morphometric]] effigies in his personal quarters.<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kubaz cigarras were mentioned on [[October 7]], [[2013]], in the second entry of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', a pair of articles written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] and released on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]].<ref name="VSV" />
